reason: I already paid for salon software once and my staff simply never used it, so it got cancelled. The money is not the problem, but I am not putting my stylists through another app they will ignore after the first week, especially when I can't afford to annoy the good ones I still have.
objection: My stylists will go back to the register book within a month, and if a phone breaks or someone leaves with it, what happens to all my customer data?
would_change_my_mind: A free one-month trial at one outlet where my own staff actually bill every walk-in on it, plus proof that the customer data is backed up somewhere safe and stays mine if a phone is lost or a stylist quits.
